# Four invoices settled out of an owner's credit, on either side of the day
# the credit arrived — the customer's on 2026-01-10 and the vendor's the same
# day, each 50.00 left over from a 150.00 payment against a 100.00 invoice.
#
#   INV-SAME / BILL-SAME    20.00, posted the day the credit landed (boundary)
#   INV-AFTER / BILL-AFTER  200.00, posted three weeks later
#
# The first takes 20.00 and closes; the second takes the last 30.00 and stays
# open for the remaining 170.00 — a credit consumed whole, which leaves no
# residual behind for anything to notice it by. The export has to say
# `from_credit: true` on all four while the invoices the bank really paid —
# INV-001 and BILL-001 — keep their `bank_account:`, `date:` and the 50.00
# those payments left over on the day they were made.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_credit_at_the_posting_date_boundary.py.

invoice "INV-SAME"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-10
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-10
		description: "Invoiced the day the deposit landed"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 20
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-10
		due: 2026-02-10
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-SAME"
		accumulate: true

invoice "INV-AFTER"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Invoiced three weeks later"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 200
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-AFTER"
		accumulate: true

bill "BILL-SAME"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-10
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-10
		description: "Billed the day the money was sent"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 20
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-10
		due: 2026-02-10
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-SAME"
		accumulate: true

bill "BILL-AFTER"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Billed three weeks later"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 200
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-AFTER"
		accumulate: true
